_comment: Per-dimension overrides for Civillis civilization + head spawn stages.
civilization — optional, default true. false skips zone + score spawn logic
(getCScoreAt returns 0 without computing); head stages still run unless head_mechanics is false.
head_mechanics — optional, default true. false skips HEAD_NEARBY / HEAD_SUPPRESS.
replace: true clears all policies loaded so far from earlier files (lexicographic by resource id).
Later entries for the same dimension override earlier ones.
